name: TROPYNIN-AS
notes: AnchoredIP (https://anchoredip.com) leases dedicated IPv4 address space out of AS41800 and delivers it to a customer's existing machines over a WireGuard tunnel, so that a server, container or CI runner has a permanent outbound identity a partner can allowlist. Addresses are announced by AS41800 with valid ROAs; reverse DNS is delegated to the customer. Single PoP in Karaganda, KZ. Peering and transit enquiries: hello@mail.anchoredip.com
